fdroid:vegabobo.dsusideloader.name: DSU Sideloader
fdroid:vegabobo.dsusideloader.summary: Easily install GSIs using Android's DSU feature
fdroid:vegabobo.dsusideloader.description:
DSU Sideloader is basically a "front-end" for Android's DSU feature.
 Android 10 or higher
 Unlocked Bootloader
 Device with Dynamic Partitions
 GSI you want to use!
For those who don't know, explaining in a really quick and simplified way, DSU (Dynamic System Updates), is a feature introduced on Android 10, that let developers boot GSIs without touching current system partition, this is done by creating new partitions to hold a GSI and a separated userdata, to boot on them when desired.
You must unlock device bootloader before using DSU, locked bootloader will only allow booting images from trusted signatures (which in reality, for most devices, means that it will only boot images signed by device OEM), for this reason, unlocked bootloader is a requirement, also, installing images with locked bootloader in some devices may be dangerous.
Once installation finishes, Android creates a persistent notification allowing you to boot into "Dynamic System" (GSI installed via DSU), and you can boot into installed GSI, without touching your system partition, or breaking the "real userdata" partition.
After booting Dynamic System, you can try and test whatever you want, when you need to switch back to device's original system image, everything you need to do, is just, a simple reboot!
You can read more about DSU Sideloader and DSU feature here: GitHub README.md

FEATURES
• Multi-device sync via your own cloud storage (Dropbox or OneDrive) — no account with Keryx itself, ever. (Google Drive sync, available in the Google Play and GitHub builds, is not part of the F-Droid build because it needs Google Play services.)
• Local-first: works fully offline, with no sync required

• Organize feeds with tags (cross-cutting labels) and folders (hierarchical grouping)
• RSS 2.0 and Atom 1.0 support (RSS 1.0/RDF is also loosely parsed)
• OPML import and export, for moving to or from other RSS readers and for backing up your subscriptions
• Completely free — no freemium tiers, no trial period, no ads
• Open source — the full source code is public and can be inspected or modified by anyone
PRIVACY
Keryx has no user accounts and no server operated by its developer. There is nothing to sign up for, and nothing that its developer's own infrastructure ever receives. The app includes no analytics, telemetry, crash reporting, advertising, or tracking of any kind. The F-Droid build contains no Google Play services and never checks for updates itself — F-Droid does that.
Keryx talks only to servers directly relevant to what you're doing: the feeds you subscribe to (and their favicons) and — only if you connect one — Dropbox or OneDrive for sync. Nothing else.
Learn more, including the full privacy policy, at https://keryx.merc.works

flathub:org.gnu.pspp.description:
GNU PSPP is a program for the statistical analysis of sampled data. It is a Free replacement for the proprietary program SPSS, and appears very similar to it with a few exceptions. The most important of these exceptions are, that there are no “time bombs”; your copy of PSPP will not “expire” or deliberately stop working in the future. Neither are there any artificial limits on the number of cases or variables which you can use. There are no additional packages to purchase in order to get “advanced” functions; all functionality that PSPP currently supports is in the core package.
 PSPP is a stable and reliable application. It can perform descriptive statistics, T-tests, anova, linear and logistic regression, measures of association, cluster analysis, reliability and factor analysis, non-parametric tests and more. Its backend is designed to perform its analyses as fast as possible, regardless of the size of the input data. You can use PSPP with its graphical interface or the more traditional syntax commands.
 A brief list of some of PSPP's features.
 Support for over 1 billion cases
 Support for over 1 billion variables
 Syntax and data files which are compatible with those of SPSS
 A choice of terminal or graphical user interface
 A choice of text, postscript, pdf, opendocument, html or TeX output formats
 Inter-operability with: LibreOffice, Apache OpenOffice, Gnumeric and other free software
 Easy data import from spreadsheets, text files and database sources
 The capability to open, analyse and edit two or more datasets concurrently
 A user interface supporting all common character sets
 The user interface has been translated to multiple languages
 Very fast statistical procedures, even on very large data sets
 No license fees and no expiration period
 No unethical “end user license agreements”
 A fully indexed user manual
 Freedom ensured; It is licensed under the GPLv3 or later
 Portability; Runs on many different computers and many different operating systems
 PSPP is particularly aimed at statisticians, social scientists and students requiring fast convenient analysis of sampled data.
 The Flatpak for PSPP includes graphical and command-line interfaces. To use the command-line interface, run: flatpak run --command=pspp org.gnu.pspp .

firefox-addons:2937971.name: ChatGPT Pro Tools
firefox-addons:2937971.summary: Chat Workspace for ChatGPT: search, filters and bulk actions in one full-screen panel, AI Tags that sort your chats by topic, plus notes, AI chat summaries, saved messages, highlights, a prompt manager and export in different formats
firefox-addons:2937971.description:
🧩 ChatGPT Pro Tools — extension that brings order to your ChatGPT chaos. AI auto-tags organize your chats by topics, so finding anything in your history takes seconds. Plus a whole set of features inside to help you get more out of ChatGPT:
=============================== 🤖 ChatGPT ===============================
🗂 Chat Workspace — a full-screen panel for all your chats in one place. Search and filter by date or tag, multi-select to bulk delete, archive, move, pin or export, and switch between list and card views with snippet previews
🏷 AI Tags — generate a tag set from your chat titles, review it, and apply it to your whole chat history in two clicks. With Pro, new chats are tagged automatically as they appear. Filter by tag in Chat Workspace and the sidebar
📅 Date filter — narrow your history by date or date range with a calendar picker
🗒 Chat notes — attach a note to any conversation
🧾 Chat summary — summarize any chat with AI at the length you pick, with emoji marking decisions, risks and open questions. The summary stays with the chat, counts the messages written since, and updates in one click
🔖 Saved messages — bookmark any assistant reply with one click
🖍 Highlights — select any text in an assistant reply and highlight it in one click
📝 Prompt Manager — save, organize, and reuse prompt templates with {{variables}}
🚀 AI Prompt Optimizer — improve your prompts (tone, length, context) right from the message box
📄 Export chat to file — save the whole chat or selected messages in different formats, with code-block syntax highlighting and LaTeX math
🏞 Images — every picture ChatGPT made you in one Chat Workspace section, by chat or by date, with each chat's tags. Open any full size or download them all in one click
🖼 Download images — save all images from a conversation in one click
📋 Copy full conversation — copy the entire chat thread to your clipboard in one click, with formatting preserved
🔢 Input counter — see character and word count as you type
✂ Message tools — collapse long messages, view per-message stats and timestamps
🔊 Audio download — save any assistant message as an audio file with voice selection
🗓 Sidebar enhancements — chat dates, date and tag filters, and bulk actions right in the native sidebar
🔄 Cloud Sync — keep your tags, notes, summaries, highlights, saved messages, and prompts in sync across all your devices; opt-in, off by default, and end-to-end encrypted
=============================== 🟠 Claude ================================
📁 Artifact folders — folders with an icon and color: add artifacts from the ⋮ menu, filter by folder
✨ Sort with AI — folders for your projects and new ones from AI, with your artifacts filed in one click
=======================================================================
⚡ Works instantly after install — no setup, no account needed
🌐 Available in 7 languages: English, Ukrainian, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Hindi
💡 Free to install — optional Pro tier. Each AI button (Generate, Apply, Optimize, Summarize, Sort with AI) gets one free cloud run a month. With Pro, cloud runs are unlimited
🔒 Privacy-first: no third-party analytics or trackers. An AI run sends only what it needs — chat titles and tag names, the prompt you optimize, the text of the chat you summarize, or artifact titles and descriptions with folder names — and none of it is stored. Usage statistics are anonymous and opt-in, and never include your chats
=======================================================================
💬 Feel free to drop a comment if you have any feature requests or ideas for improvement

apple-macos:6742335723.name: ReceiptIQ AI: Receipt Scanner
apple-macos:6742335723.description:
ReceiptIQ AI reads every line item on a receipt, not just the total — so you see what you actually bought, not only what you spent. On iPhone, iPad and Mac, with one purchase.
PERFECT FOR
• Freelancers and landlords who need itemized receipts at tax time
• Families sharing one budget across up to four devices
• Anyone tracking expenses who wants the items, not just a number
Point the camera at a receipt and let go. It waits until the paper is flat and in focus, then takes the shot itself. Seconds later the shop, the date, the tax and each individual item are filed and categorised.
Long receipts work too: show the camera the top, then the bottom, and both parts are joined into one receipt, or join two photos from your library. Each receipt also keeps its payment method (card type and last 4 digits), time, receipt number, seller tax number and tax per rate. Edit them, search by them and find them in CSV and PDF exports.
WHAT IT CAPTURES
• Paper receipts, with the camera on iPhone or iPad.
• E-receipts and screenshots. Share an Amazon order, an Uber receipt or an emailed invoice into the app from the share sheet.
• Email receipts. Turn on your personal forwarding address and forward order confirmations to it; you review each one before it is saved. Your mailbox is never connected.
• On the Mac: photos, PDF files and receipts dragged onto the window.
